name: Gideon, Ally of Zendikar
text: [+1]: Until end of turn, Gideon, Ally of Zendikar becomes a 5/5 Human Soldier Ally creature with indestructible that's still a planeswalker. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to him this turn.\n[0]: Create a 2/2 white Knight Ally creature token.\n[−4]: You get an emblem with "Creatures you control get +1/+1."
rulings: [{'date': '2015-08-25', 'text': 'Gideon’s first ability causes him to become a creature with the creature types Human, Soldier, and Ally. He remains a planeswalker with the planeswalker type Gideon. (He also retains any other card types or subtypes he may have had.)
